name: Warlpiri religion (Jukurrpa)

dating.dating_summary: Central Australian regional occupation is dated to ~38,000-47,830 BP (Karnatukul/Serpent's Glen) but this is regional-occupation evidence, not a date for any specific Jukurrpa narrative; the earliest outsider documentation is Meggitt's 1953-79 fieldwork (published 1962) and Munn's 1956-58 fieldwork (published 1973); no independently verified oral-transmission-depth estimate exists for any specific Warlpiri ceremony.

earliest_archaeological_evidence.note: Karnatukul (Serpent's Glen), Western Desert adjacent to the Tanami: re-dated to before 47,830 cal BP median modelled age (Veth et al., revised chronology, Australian Archaeology). A general baseline of ~38,000 BP is also cited for Central Australian interior occupation. Regional occupation evidence only — not a date for Jukurrpa content.

earliest_written_attestation.note: Mervyn J. Meggitt, Desert People: A Study of the Walbiri Aborigines of Central Australia (Sydney: Angus & Robertson, 1962), fieldwork from 1953. Nancy D. Munn, Walbiri Iconography (Cornell UP, 1973), fieldwork at Yuendumu 1956-58.

tradition_internal_claim.note: Christine Nicholls, "What does Jukurrpa ('Dreamtime', 'the Dreaming') mean?", Australian Aboriginal Studies (AIATSIS), 2014: Jukurrpa is set in a "fictitious" past by Warlpiri's own framing, but continues to exist in and act on the present — five interrelated usages (era, beings, manifestations of power, binding law, personal totemic inheritance).

estimated_oral_origin.method: No dated study of any specific Warlpiri Jukurrpa narrative was located using any stated method.

notes: Category tags reflect a system combining ancestor-linked totemic inheritance with law/moral order; "primitive"/evolutionary-stage framing explicitly rejected. Documented internal historical change (not static/timeless): Georgia Curran, "'Waiting for Jardiwanpa': History and Mediation in Warlpiri Fire Ceremonies," Oceania 89(2) (2019), documents post-sedentarization shifts in the Jardiwanpa ceremony's social purpose and the standardization of payment for filmed/public performance beginning in the 1990s.
